title: Junior MERN Stack Developer
description: We are looking for a motivated Junior MERN Stack Developer with 1-2 years of experience to join our fast-growing startup. You should have a solid foundation in MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js, and a passion for building great user experiences. This is a great opportunity to grow quickly in a startup environment.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain features across the MERN stack
Implement UI components based on design mockups
Integrate frontend with backend REST APIs
Participate in daily standups and agile ceremonies
requirements: 1-2 years of experience with the MERN stack
Ability to work with REST APIs
Eagerness to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment
